critical_code_review_comments: BulkScorecardPrintOverlay.jsx — the on-screen opacity-70 watermark is helpful for QA but at 34px SVG + tracking-widest wordmark, it can dominate the preview modal for single-card rounds. Consider dropping to opacity-50 on-screen (still opacity 1 in @media print via the existing rule) so the actual scorecard remains the visual focus in the preview.

RoundCard.jsx completed variant renders the winner chip only when winner_name is present; the null-fallback branch is correct. If backend ever back-fills a legacy completed round WITHOUT re-running _finalize_round, those docs will render 'Winner · —'. Consider a lightweight one-shot migration to fill winner_name/winner_id on historic completed rounds so the archive is uniformly populated.

StandingsTab.jsx — nice bag-tag matrix + white card sweep, but the <table class='ledger-grid'> still uses the ledger-grid CSS class which historically shipped dark-zinc styles. Verified visually the rows render fine in the emerald theme, but audit ledger-grid CSS in App.css/index.css to make sure it isn't still declaring text-zinc-* colors that get overridden inline. Not blocking.

LedgerTab.jsx — tab shell verified clean of dark surfaces; because the test league had no ledger rows, the emerald chip variants (chip-orange/green migration) could not be visually asserted end-to-end. Recommend a one-off manual QA once a real league has ledger activity, or extend future pytest to seed a ledger row.
